mechanism.name: First-adopter Cox adoption with AR(1) outcomes conditional on whole-experiment success

generation_equations.label: adoption
generation_equations.expression: X~U[-10,10]; Ti|Xi~Exp(exp(1+.5Xi)); H=max10000 sample15%quantiles; condition minTi<H

sampling.unit: Exactly25 unit rows and1000 outcomes; horizon random from10000 calibration panels
sampling.dependence: Shared random horizon and success conditioning induce panel-design dependence; conditional innovations iid normal with unit AR1 recursion.

assumptions: Native additive tau0, consistency; successful generation ensures nonempty pre/post.

properties.notes: Observed X drives exponential adoption; first adopter selection; zero-initial unit AR outcomes.

estimand.name: ATT_cond
estimand.definition: Mean effect on first-adopter post cells in whole-experiment-success conditional population; also realized SATT=0 pathwise

truth.expression: Mean effect on first-adopter post cells in whole-experiment-success conditional population; also realized SATT=0 pathwise
truth.derivation: Pathwise additive null conditional on successful whole experiment

adaptations: Explicit user approval: conditional mechanism adaptation with full population/distribution disclosure.
Condition on generation success min(T)<Tmax; reject whole experiment including10000 calibration panels. Original driver shared calibration, this contribution uses fresh calibration per experiment.
Author-code parameters beta.5/intercept1/sigma.15/delta.5 and1000-point index-time AR differ from paper; first adopter response only.
Conditional Tmax reweighted and X/group dependence altered; not original unconditional reproduction.
NumPy local RNG and vectorized calibration preserve mathematical laws, not R bitstream.
warnings: Latent-variable candidates inferred from source equations; confirm their roles and completeness against the original paper or generator.
